adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U show two distinct, sustained offsets centered near JJ12 and JJ34 with clear opposing jumps and recovery across all axes. The interior (e.g., indices 467–473) remains stable after onset and before return, supporting genuine temporary platforms. P1 (463–475) and P2 (464–476) overlap and are inconsistent with observed return timing: residuals after subtraction (Hypotheses P1/P2) still show persistent offset in N/E until ~476–477, and U shows incomplete recovery until ~477. The numerical tool’s best fit (first=464, second=477) aligns better with observed return at ~477 in original data. Thus, a single non-overlapping platform from ~464 to ~477 is supported; neither P1 nor P2 alone is correct, and they cannot both be retained.
